text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As I approach the training course, I spy
Vodka talking to another
student.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
C'mon, you and me—let's race fair and
square! I don't need no head
start!

text_block_list.name: Classmate
text_block_list.text:
Vodka's been challenging the seniors to
races left and right these
days... I wonder
what's gotten into her.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Here we go, last corner! It's make or break
time—and I'm gonna
caaatch uuup!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, despite being in hot pursuit of
her opponent, she fails to
close the
distance.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Pant... pant... Well, I'll let you have this one...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
But it won't happen again! I'm gonna leave
all you pace chasers in the
dust, so watch
out! The soon-to-be world's coolest racer
is comin'
after ya!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
(Aw yeah, I'm so cool! Now everyone
knows that no matter how many
times I
lose, I'm gonna get back up and keep
goin'!)

text_block_list.name: Older Student
text_block_list.text:
Okay, whatever you say. You're cute when
you're so hyped up.
Anyway, catch ya
later.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Hell yeah! Wait a sec... Aren't you
intimidated at all? Like, I have
hidden
powers, y'know! Hey!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer, I wanna talk to you about
something. Did you catch my
race just
now?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I was all like, "I'm gonna leave you in the
dust!" to be super cool,
but...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Now that I think about it, wasn't that kinda
lame? I bet all the seniors
think I'm just a
kid with a big mouth.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Honestly, it sounds like something a
clichéd villain would say. Like,
"You
haven't seen the last of me!"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
You serious?! Oh man, it wasn't like this
before I entered the
academy. For starters,
losing in a race wasn't a thing for me...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
But Tracen's got tons of talented folks, so
of course I'd lose on
occasion. And every
time it happens, I can't help but feel sore
about
it.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I suppose. I could give that a try. All
right, lemme do a quick
practice sesh.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Ahem, ahem... Okay, here I go. "Heh,
looks like I lost. I accept my
defeat. See
you later."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
.........But I'm gonna get ya next time! I'll
utterly destroy you!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Ughhh, I came off as an actual villain this
time! How the hell do
people casually
accept defeat and move on?!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
...Sorry. I think I'm gonna go. This is
pathetic...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As Vodka hurries off, I quickly follow
behind her.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, Trainer. Didn't mean to worry you.
It's just... I don't know what
being "cool"
even is anymore.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
It's good that I'm facing tough opponents
head-on, but I'm starting to
wonder if I
should be dropping one-liners.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
It just comes out on its own! I... got it from
my pops. He'd always say
stuff like "you're
lacking heart," or "looks like you're only
second
best."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
He was the one who taught me that it's
cool to drop one-liners after a
match.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
But if I don't win, it's kinda lame. I don't
wanna be all talk and no
show. That's why
I need your help, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Can you teach me what it actually means to be cool? You're the only one who knows how cool I really am.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Do you think you can help me grow even
more?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Thanks! Just knowing that you're by my
side makes me feel a lot
better! I'm gonna
discover what it means to be genuinely
cool. Oh
and...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I-I'll also need help to overcome my
weakness. Y'know... whenever I
see
lovey-dovey romantic stuff, I get shivers
down my spine.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I'm not sayin' I'm embarrassed though!
Don't you dare get me wrong.
You better
not tell anyone else about this, or else I'll
send ya flyin'!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Before Vodka turns around and rushes off,
I manage to catch a
glimpse of her flushed
cheeks.
